message:
Amara, Baraka and Dalia, the proposal now matches the agreed staged peak through the revised integrated store proposal (v2).

Plainly one daily lot plus wall leak sets the size. The average pull-down power (E57) of 1.04e3 W plus 185 W wall leak in the steady load simulation (E31) needs about 1.00e3 W cooling from variable-speed Direct Current unit, where Direct Current (DC) means battery-type power, drawing 662 W electric in the peak power calculation (E60) and 13.8 A at 48 V in the peak current calculation (E61), microwave scale so the skid and roof rails carry it unchanged.

Amara, Baraka and Dalia, the door still seals and crates still cannot fall out.

Plainly soft-strip squeeze keeps warm air out and a lip holds each shelf. The seal detail sketch (E59) shows 3 mm squeeze on the 800 mm door, house-door scale so a person with a crate passes, with 50 mm guard rails holding 20 kg lifts, luggage scale so cooperative hands cope.

Amara, Baraka and Dalia, the chamber stays roomy and the floor load stays light.

Plainly air still moves around the tonne. The chamber simulation (E44) of 10.6 cubic metres at 27.1 percent fill is bedroom scale, and the floor pressure calculation (E43) of 2.04 kPa is about one tenth of a person standing so plywood spreaders spread it. I am ready, because the revised proposal carries the agreed peak and the enclosure case survives.
